basic_info.description: This charming three-unit building is situated in a prime location on Nob Hill close to North Beach, Chinatown, and the Financial District. 970 Broadway offers great views of downtown and has undergone a recent remodel and is now ready for occupancy. 968A Broadway, the lower tenant-occupied unit has also been recently renovated to the same quality as 970 Broadway. The rear unit, 968 Broadway, is a two-story occupied unit in excellent condition.
